Maria V: heads-up — planning to tweak the evening handoff cadence starting next week. propose 2 items: 1) 20m triage at 19:00 UTC, 2) mandatory escalation liaisons on call until midnight. thoughts?

Josh K: 19:00 UTC works for APAC overlap. Do we keep current pager rotation or do liaisons split across teams?

Devon L: Suggest we keep rotation but add a 'liaison' pin for each incident in the bridge. Liaison handles vendor escalations + exec updates.

Sam R: can we add a short pre-handoff checklist? e.g., open incidents, pending deploys, any DB jobs running. saves time.

Maria V: yes — draft checklist below. + we'll make it a channel post before 18:50. anyone want to add items?

Maria V: ```pre-handoff checklist:
- list open incidents with SEV
- confirm scheduled deploys + rollbacks
- KV cache migrations running?
- outstanding P1 alerts: pager duty link
- contact list: escalation liaisons (primary/secondary)
```

Josh K: add 'recent config changes in prod' and 'active external outages'

Devon L: + please ensure dedicated liaison for vendor S3 issues (we had confusion last week).

oncall-bot: Reminder pinned — evening-handoff meeting 19:00 UTC. Join here: https://meet.link/hand-off :bell:

Sam R: who volunteers for liaison Mon-Wed? I'll take Mon.

Ira P: I'll take Tue/Wed mornings are rough for me. can do Wed night if needed.

Maria V: thanks Sam + Ira. Need Wed night backup — @Josh K you ok to be backup on Wed 19:00-00:00?

Josh K: yep, can back Wed night.

Devon L: propose we test a canary fallback during meeting — 5m drill switching to secondary model node. quick confirmation?

Maria V: good idea. add a 5-min fallback drill at 19:15 in agenda.

Sam R: LGTM. I'll update the calendar invite and add the checklist to the meeting description. :thumbsup: 

Maria V: final ask — please react with :white_check_mark: if you'll attend this week. if not, ping who will cover.

Josh K: :white_check_mark:

Sam R: :white_check_mark:

Ira P: :white_check_mark:

Devon L: :white_check_mark:
